question: Which mantra elements are placed on the face in this nyāsa instruction?
premises: The face is specified as the location.
Māyā is named as an element.
inference: On the face one places or invokes māyā together with Nityaklinne and Madadrave.
uncertainties: The precise ritual function of each named element in this placement is not fully explicit.
plain_english: On the face: māyā, O Nityaklinne, O Madadrave.
